title: UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE requests bearer resource allocation and network accepts it, leading to either dedicated EPS bearer context activation or EPS bearer context modification.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request bearer resource allocation.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: IE containing the EPS bearer identity to verify against active default EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by MME to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by MME to modify an existing EPS bearer context.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to modify an existing EPS bearer context.

entities.name: T3480
entities.description: Timer started by UE during bearer resource allocation procedure; stopped upon receiving ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST with matching PTI.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by UE after stopping timer T3480 upon receiving matching ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Identifier assigned to the procedure; used to match messages and manage retransmissions.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: IE used in ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST and MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST to identify the EPS bearer.

entities.name: Active default EPS bearer context
entities.description: Condition checked by MME to verify if Linked EPS bearer identity IE matches any active default EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity not already used
entities.description: Condition verified by UE upon receiving ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST to ensure EPS bearer identity is not already used.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity is active
entities.description: Condition verified by UE upon receiving MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST to ensure EPS bearer identity matches an active EPS bearer context.

relations.description: Bearer resource allocation procedure involves sending BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message.
BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message contains Linked EPS bearer identity IE.
Bearer resource allocation procedure may initiate dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure.
Bearer resource allocation procedure may initiate EPS bearer context modification procedure.
Receiving ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST with matching PTI stops timer T3480.
Receiving MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST with matching PTI stops timer T3480.
Receiving ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST with matching PTI causes UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
Receiving MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST with matching PTI causes UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
Linked EPS bearer identity IE is verified against condition of being an active default EPS bearer context.
EPS bearer identity IE in ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST is verified against condition of not being already used.
EPS bearer identity IE in MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST is verified against condition of being an active EPS bearer context.
BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message includes procedure transaction identity.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message includes procedure transaction identity for matching.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message includes procedure transaction identity for matching.
